Length of rolls: $300 \times 4\text{ inches} = 1200\text{ inches} = 100\text{ feet}$
Length of croissants: $120 \times 6\text{ inches} = 720\text{ inches} = 60\text{ feet}$
Length of baguettes: $60 \times 2\text{ feet} = 120\text{ feet}$

Total length = $100 + 60 + 120 = 280\text{ feet}$

ANSWER: 280
